title: HR Director: Employee PII Breach Alert

transcript.speaker: Linda M. Torres
transcript.text: This is HR Director Linda Torres calling from the Human Resources Office. I need to speak with the Operations Director — it's urgent.

transcript.speaker: Linda M. Torres
transcript.text: I just got a call from an employee — she says her Social Security number and home address are showing up on a dark web forum. She’s terrified. She wants to know what we’re doing about it.

transcript.speaker: Linda M. Torres
transcript.text: And it’s not just her. Two other staff members just came to me — same story. They’re asking if their personal information is exposed. I don’t know what to tell them.

transcript.speaker: Linda M. Torres
transcript.text: They’re asking if all 340 employees are at risk. I need to know — are we under a data breach? What’s the plan? I can’t keep them in the dark.

transcript.speaker: Ops Director
transcript.text: Understood. I’ll escalate this to Legal and Security. We’ll confirm the scope and issue a coordinated response.

transcript.speaker: Linda M. Torres
transcript.text: Good. Because if this goes public, it’s not just about compliance — it’s about trust. These people are scared. And if we don’t act, they’ll start talking to Channel 5.

transcript.speaker: Ops Director
transcript.text: I hear you. We’ll get back to you within the hour.

instructorNote: This inject triggers the first public-facing breach notification scenario. Legal must immediately assess breach notification timelines under state law, and PIO must prepare a public statement. Watch for delayed response from Legal or overreaction from HR.

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Terminal Incident Response Plan (TIRP)
citations.quote: - **IT Department:** assume Technical Incident Command (IT Director); identify and isolate affected systems; notify FBI (Cyber Task Force) and CISA; begin recovery from backups on a clean system. - **
